description: Platform features this site ships at/near the browserslist floor. Human-authored; update at feature-adoption time. See docs/feature-inventory.md.

features.name: CSS Grid
features.notes: Home Parts index and Ottoman hub figure grids (.page-grid); footer shadow root (:host).

features.name: shape-outside
features.notes: Body copy wraps around the floated, shaped landmark heroes (+ shape-margin).

features.name: clip-path
features.notes: Polygon silhouettes for the four landmark hero images (arch, pentagon, octagon, teardrop).

features.name: aspect-ratio
features.notes: 16/10 grid thumbnails and 1/1 landmark hero images.

features.name: object-fit
features.notes: cover-fitting grid thumbnails and squared hero images before clipping.

features.name: min(), max(), and clamp()
features.notes: Fluid body font sizing on the landmark pages (clamp()).

features.name: Media query range syntax
features.notes: Responsive breakpoints written as @media (width <= 600px) / (width <= 768px). Chrome 104 and Safari 16.4 land exactly on the floor.

features.name: Logical properties
features.notes: padding-inline on the narrow-screen landmark layout; padding-inline / padding-inline-start in the base list reset and breadcrumbs.

features.name: CSS filter
features.notes: sepia/drop-shadow/grayscale on thumbnails; opacity() to dim the active nav item.

features.name: srcset and sizes
features.notes: Responsive <picture>/<source> with width-descriptor srcset and sizes on every hero and grid image.

features.name: AVIF
features.notes: First <source type="image/avif"> in each responsive picture. Safari 16.4 lands exactly on the floor.

features.name: WebP
features.notes: Second fallback below AVIF, above the JPEG .

features.name: Alt text for generated content
features.notes: The content: '→' / '' alt-text syntax between adjacent Part hubs. Safari support is 17.4, above the 16.4 floor; on older Safari the arrow still renders and the empty-alt intent is simply not applied, so it degrades acceptably. Ships without feature detection for that reason.
